notes: All three papers are open access under CC BY 4.0; the license statement was verified in the PDF text itself (quotes recorded per entry), which permits redistribution with attribution.

MDPI article pages (www.mdpi.com) and the Politecnico di Torino IRIS mirror (iris.polito.it) rejected direct programmatic downloads (HTTP 403 / Cloudflare challenge). PDFs were instead fetched from the MDPI distribution CDN mdpi-res.com using the /d_attachment/<journal>/<journal>-<vol>-<article>/article_deploy/<journal>-<vol>-<article>.pdf path pattern.

A fourth candidate (open-access P2D parameterization paper hosted at ebiltegia.mondragon.edu, handle 20.500.11984/6203) could not be retrieved from this network (connection timeout after 133 s, HTTP 000) and was abandoned for this batch.

A supplementary file for Dessantis et al. (Figure S1 is referenced in the article) was not located under the tested mdpi-res.com patterns (batteries-09-00146-s001.pdf returned an HTML error page); the corpus supplement requirement is already covered by chen2020_supplement_s1.
